# bb commit

Commit inspection and compare commands

4 commands.

[`bb commit compare`](#bb-commit-compare)
:   Compare two commits or refs

[`bb commit get`](#bb-commit-get)
:   Get a specific commit

[`bb commit list`](#bb-commit-list)
:   List repository commits

[`bb commit prs`](#bb-commit-prs)
:   List pull requests containing a commit

## `bb commit compare`

Compare two commits or refs

```text
bb commit compare <from> <to> [flags]
```

List the commits reachable from &lt;from&gt; but not from &lt;to&gt;: what &lt;from&gt; has that &lt;to&gt; lacks. Pass the ref you are asking about first; git log's range puts it last.

```text
bb commit compare feature/x main        # commits feature/x adds
bb commit compare <failing> <green>     # commits since the last green build
```

`--all`
:   Return every result rather than the first --limit

`--limit int`
:   Maximum number of results to return (default 25)

Inherited from [`bb commit`](#bb-commit):

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug (defaults to BITBUCKET\_PROJECT\_KEY + BITBUCKET\_REPO\_SLUG)

`--start int`
:   Start offset for list operations

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Runs as usual: this command changes nothing, so there is nothing to hold back

## `bb commit list`

List repository commits

```text
bb commit list [flags]
```

`--all`
:   Return every result rather than the first --limit

`--jira string`
